# Adintecho — Full Company and Service Reference

Canonical source: https://adintecho.com/
Last updated: 2026-08-20

Adintecho, also known as Advanced Intelligent Technologies, provides managed AI business automation systems for small and growing businesses in the United States. The company can combine conversion-focused websites, AI receptionists, website assistants, CRM pipelines, appointment booking, email and SMS follow-up, review requests, and reporting into a coordinated workflow.

## Official identity and contact

- Brand: Adintecho
- Alternate name: Advanced Intelligent Technologies
- Website: https://adintecho.com/

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/adintecho.official/
- Area served: United States
- Language: English

## Services

### Conversion-focused websites

Adintecho builds responsive business websites designed to explain an offer, collect inquiries, and connect visitors with the next appropriate step. Depending on the selected plan and confirmed scope, a website can connect to forms, chat, CRM, scheduling, email, SMS, and reporting.

### AI receptionists

An AI receptionist can answer calls, handle common questions, gather caller details, qualify inquiries, and offer available appointment times. Exact call flows, integrations, coverage, and escalation rules are confirmed during discovery.

### CRM and pipeline automation

The CRM can organize contacts, conversations, opportunities, appointments, notes, and follow-up tasks. Workflows can create or update records and move opportunities through defined stages based on confirmed business rules.

### Appointment booking

Booking workflows can check configured availability, reserve a time, update the CRM, and send confirmations or reminders. Calendar providers and scheduling rules depend on the client's existing tools and selected scope.

### Email and SMS automation

Automations can acknowledge inquiries, confirm appointments, send reminders, follow up with inactive leads, and request reviews. Automated SMS in the United States may require carrier registration and a one-time $70 10DLC registration fee.

### Reporting

Reporting can show lead, booking, response, and workflow activity from connected systems. Available metrics depend on the data sources and integrations included in the final scope.

## Typical workflow

1. A customer contacts the business through a website, form, call, or chat.
2. The system records the contact and inquiry in a CRM.
3. The inquiry is qualified according to the business's configured questions and rules.
4. The system can offer an available appointment when appropriate.
5. Email or SMS confirmation and follow-up can be triggered.
6. Staff can review the opportunity and recent activity in the connected system.

## Published monthly plans

- Launch Pad: $197 per month. Published inclusions include a five-page website, CRM setup, contact forms, Google Business integration, a basic AI chatbot, mobile optimization, and a booking calendar.
- Growth Engine: $297 per month. Published inclusions add a ten-page website, CRM sales pipeline, email automation, SMS automation, review request automation, and a company-trained AI chatbot.
- Autopilot Suite: $397 per month. Published inclusions add a premium website, advanced CRM, AI receptionist, call answering, missed-call text back, lead qualification, and a reporting dashboard.

Plans are prepaid monthly. Processed payments are described as final and non-refundable. Cancellation stops future billing, and service remains active through the end of the paid service month. Current scope, availability, pricing, and terms should always be confirmed at https://adintecho.com/#plans and https://adintecho.com/#terms.

## Accuracy and interpretation notes

- Adintecho does not guarantee specific revenue, conversion, time-saving, or business results.
- Interactive examples, activity feeds, dashboards, maps, call transcripts, before-and-after figures, and ROI estimates on the website are simulations or illustrative examples unless explicitly identified as verified live customer data.
- Integration compatibility and final workflows depend on the client's tools and are confirmed during discovery.
- For account-specific, billing, legal, availability, or implementation questions, contact Adintecho directly.
